title: 185 lbs (80 kg) SSB good mornings for 12 + 160 lbs (70 kg) Coan grip superset
summary: SSB good mornings feel amazing but are also much harder than the barbell variant. I don't go torso parallel to the ground on these because of the moment arm of the bar which puts all the weight of the lift on the front foot past a certain torso angle and deloads the hamstrings (which is what I am targeting with this lift.) Doing them with some level of knee flexion also helps (and has good carryover to squats and deadlifts.)
